subject: Post-demo procurement route, PO vs card, marketplace & billing start conditions
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@everstream.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@everstream.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up from today's demo + procurement question

Karthik — thanks for the demo earlier. Team liked the latency numbers and the dashboard. A couple of items procurement asked me to confirm before we proceed to trial:

- Which payment paths does Redwood accept for a pilot we intend to move to paid (PO vs corporate card vs marketplace)?
- If we go PO, do you require a signed SOW or is a PO referencing an MSA sufficient?
- Trial billing: when does billing start exactly — first token served, or after we flip to production? We have usage thresholds that would trigger chargeback to the product team and need to line that up.

Folks from procurement are looped above. If you can send a short note with the options and what paperwork is required, that'll help speed our internal approval.

Best,
Samantha
Director of ML Platforms
EverStream AI

Attachment: RFP-brief.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@everstream.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@everstream.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's demo + procurement question

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, then proposed next steps.

Options (summary):
- Card: Fastest to start, no paperwork beyond a billing contact and card to place charges. Good if you want zero friction trial.
- PO: Supported. We accept a PO that references our standard MSA/terms. If procurement requires a counter-signed SOW for scope/billing cadence, we can provide a one-page SOW template (attached).
- Marketplace: We are listed on the Redwood Cloud Marketplace (via partner portal). Marketplace purchases work but introduce ~2-week marketplace processing lag for billing start and invoicing reconciliation.

Billing start: For pilots we typically start metered billing once you explicitly flip the trial account to "chargeable" in the console (requested by the customer's admin). We can also configure an automatic start after a configured usage threshold if you prefer (e.g., 250k tokens or 1,000 API calls).

Next steps I propose:
1) Monica / Ben (cc'd) — can you confirm Finance/Contract team availability to review a PO + SOW this coming week?
2) Samantha — tell us your preferred path (card / PO / marketplace) and whether procurement needs a counter-signed SOW.
3) If PO: we'll issue a short SOW draft and MSA excerpt for legal review; if Marketplace: I'll sync with our partner ops.

Attaching: EverStream_SOW_v0.1.pdf (draft), pricing-grid.xlsx

Cheers,
Karthik
Enterprise GTM Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@everstream.ai>, procurement@everstream.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's demo + procurement question

Karthik / Ben — quick internal checklist from Finance/legal: 

- PO path: Acceptable. We require the PO to reference the Redwood MSA (we'll provide the MSA excerpt). Typical turnaround for our counter-signature is 3–5 business days once legal gets a clean PO.
- Card: We can onboard with card immediately; we will set a billing contact and start with a monthly card reconciliation.
- Marketplace: We support it, but note the marketplace sync may delay invoicing; our recommendation for pilots that want immediate usage visibility is to avoid marketplace for the initial 30 days.

On billing start/shutdown rules: we can set a billing "go-live" toggle that the customer's admin flips. Also supporting threshold-based triggers — e.g., start billing automatically only after 300k consumed tokens OR 14 calendar days of trial usage, whichever comes first. If EverStream wants thresholds, we need the exact numeric thresholds to set in the tenant config ahead of time.

Action for us: I'll prepare a 1-page SOW template and an MSA excerpt and send to Samantha + procurement by EOD tomorrow. Ben — can you confirm pricing tier and whether we can offer a 14-day grace window before charging for first-time pilots on card?

Monica
Director, Partnerships Operations (Finance liaisons)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-terms-summary.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@everstream.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's demo + procurement question

Samantha — we can do the 14-day grace on card for first-time pilots (no charge until the grace period ends). For PO customers, invoicing will follow the PO terms (net30 by default) once the PO is accepted and the account toggled to chargeable. Pricing tier for the trial: we'll provision the trial at the "Standard Eval" tier (1M free tokens cap for the pilot) unless you want a custom cap.

If EverStream confirms PO route, we need: PO document, billing contact, and preferred invoice remit address. If card route, we need the cardholder email and billing contact and we'll provision immediately.

Ben
Senior Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@everstream.ai>, procurement@everstream.ai
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's demo + procurement question

Thanks all — Samantha, appreciate the quick clarifications. To summarize and capture the concrete next steps so procurement has an action list:

- EverStream to confirm path by EOD Thu, Nov 26: card (fastest) OR PO (we accept PO referencing Redwood MSA) OR marketplace (2-week delay).
- If PO chosen: EverStream to send PO + billing contact. Redwood will return signed acknowledgement within 3–5 business days and provide invoice cadence (net30 default).
- If card chosen: provide cardholder email and billing contact; Redwood to enable trial immediately and apply a 14-day grace period before any charges.
- Trial-to-paid gating: Redwood will not start metered charges until the tenant admin toggles "chargeable" or after the agreed threshold is reached (default threshold suggested: 300k tokens OR 14 days of active trial). Please confirm which threshold you'd like us to configure.

I'll follow up with the one-page SOW and MSA excerpt (Monica will send). Once we have a path selected we can schedule a short intake call with our partner ops to set tenant config.

Karthik
Enterprise GTM Lead
Redwood Inference
